<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO impact:</strong> Shares of BSE and MCX fell up to 5% following Jefferies&#x27; report highlighting the NSE&#x27;s dominant market position and diversification ahead of its anticipated $3 billion IPO in September.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPWEpXdnkxN3pYcXZIV1c2SU1ZM2MtcmxDRlAxa0tFcE9xQXZKVWdJYXB4M1B0TGZ4RkdQMzlTbWlIcnUzaDNRcGRIY1NIaEpRMjVPMWl3M1BMSUpXc2VkOGhteEhDaDZzWWZKcldJeXM0Zy1CaFVIWV9VTkhzQlVVSElOY3FSeXY4WWdzdVJGcVBKTGtjdjJ3bnRLODdQalloMVV2TzJzYmNnZW0zbzg4b2tfSkdFRVRGU2xUckxTRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPYTRZMjQ2RF9VNDFaeFBzckNQUXE2em5ualdkdFR5MW5kSHR5eGZyaGRISDBsazJaQ0FfZ2VfeEY5dVRYSERnVzM1Tk5BN3dpOWFrc2ZKbmowNHpZMkpDWjdyaGdERmJsbVdVYjJHTF9jWFdFbVd1UklzMG1UeUl5cTEwT0ZkTVl6dDd6OVpzSmNfZEFEQWdPRFdXQks5OGtJWVRIOGJFODNqTG5oRUdqSXZlQkF2UWp0N213R05Bdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI liquidity measures:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India plans to infuse ₹3 trillion into the banking system through Open Market Operations (OMO) and forex swaps to manage liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNbUFoX0FtdVltQmREWkx3WDkzdHZpR2RwS1NuS1E1ZzRGTVUtWHBuZXVYSnl3TkRmV1A5NC11S2E5dGtRaFpNdjY0QzhXcVg1akZVVHJOcnkxZFh5R3BzUkctek1JTk9BYWdTM2hpaHJQVmFOb1hGTU5tZHFreW90cy1NeE9PbmlaTEVDUXJ5UTBqck4wX1dBNWt2cTBEdjRRbjNnLUxyTE5kQUdla3EyX0h3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty snapped a four-day winning streak as investors engaged in profit booking, offsetting earlier gains driven by IT sector strength.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Bond yields and inflows:</strong> Indian 10-year bond yields are hovering near March lows at 6.69%, supported by favorable monsoon progress and steady FII inflows into Fully Accessible Route (FAR) securities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic outlook:</strong> Analysts suggest that falling crude oil prices are providing the RBI with increased policy room to support growth and manage inflation, though domestic monsoon performance remains a critical variable for interest rate trajectories.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
